name: eval-conductor
description: Know whether a change made your AI system worse, and prove it. A fail-closed CI gate for the scores you already produce (pytest, claude plugin eval, promptfoo, any JSON) that BLOCKs on a regression, a NaN or missing metric, a stale baseline or a quietly edited threshold. Every PROMOTE/BLOCK is a signed, tamper-evident receipt, and you can seal the bar before a run to prove it wasn't moved after the results came in. /eval-prove turns your existing tests into a signed proof and PR badge with zero setup. Includes a 27-step evidence-gated build ledger.
